title: How one Rajasthan village revived its commons
description: In Soniyana village of Rajasthan’s Bhilwara district, home to around 80 households, residents faced a familiar challenge – the village’s 200 bighas of grazing land (charagah), of which 50 bighas are currently protected, were gradually degrading.
